title: Create once, publish everywhere — cross-posting tool promo

source.author: @jackfriks
source.note: Remade from scratch in HyperFrames after the Post Bridge promo; structure and pacing follow it. Brand, logo and copy are ours and fictional; the real platform logos are replaced with generic channel icons, and the platform names with channel types.

scenes: green line, headline letters rise through it
headline swings away, channel icons orbit a video card
card zooms into a composer: typed caption, channel chips, click with ripples
ten phones fill one by one while a counter climbs to 10/10
channel words cut on alternating backgrounds, then the payoff line
chat request, typing dots, week calendar, scheduled confirmation
white burst into the logo lockup, tagline and domain
